findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed from DetectorHandler (which it implemented with `return []`) to StatefulDetectorHandler with `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler adds new abstract members: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. A subclass that does not implement them remains abstract, so `group_type.detector_handler(self)` in Detector.detector_handler will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class when the detector type is metric_alert_fire. Previously this handler was concrete.

findings.title: get_state_data KeyErrors when detector has no counters
findings.body: In get_state_data, `counter_updates` is initialized to `{}` and only populated inside `if self.counter_names:`. The result construction unconditionally does `counter_updates=counter_updates[gk]`. For any StatefulDetectorHandler with `counter_names == []`, this raises KeyError on every evaluate, crashing detection. It should default to an empty dict per group key when there are no counters.
